About this item

  • 【Professional Knife Set】16 piece kitchen knife set includes: 8" chef knife, 8" bread knife, 8" carving knife, 7" santoku knife, 7" fillet knife, 6" utility knife, 3.75" paring knife, 6pcs 4.5" steak knives, a knife sharpener, a pair of kitchen shears all stored in a knife block
  • 【Razor Shape Blade】The knife blade is sharpened with the latest sharpening technology to create a sharp angle of 15 degrees, which can cut tender meat, fish, fruits, vegetables, etc; With extreme precision, without tearing the food, allowing you to preserve the taste in the best way
  • 【Forged Japanese Steel】Made of high-quality Japanese 10Cr15CoMoV stainless steel, it has strong resistance to stain and rust; After high-temperature forging, the hardness reaches up to 58 HRC, which ensures that the kitchen knife is durable and remains sharp even in daily use
  • 【Ergonomic Handle】The handle is made of high-density pakkawood, which is not easy to crack and is famous for its hardness and exterior; The handle is designed to fit the palm perfectly, providing optimal grip and comfort, and will not cause fatigue when used for a long time
  • 【Easy Care & Store】HOSHANHO chef knife set comes with a knife holder with a ventilation design at the bottom, which is suitable for long-term storage of knives; The knife block set also comes with a sharpening rod for daily maintenance and sharpness maintenance of knives

  • Alan Bell
    5 out of 5 stars
    Beautiful set.
    Reviewed in the United States on May 27, 2026
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This is a very nice mid-range kitchen knife set. The steel used is actually named and is a good solid stainless steel that's a good balance for a set like this. The handles are beautiful and look high-end. The only thing I find a little odd is the scissors. The little swivel lock fell out and the spring disappeared somewhere in the kitchen within the first week of use. They still work OK but seem a bit over-complicated for kitchen scissors. They blades are very sharp out of box - so be careful.

    A little warning for you all if you get these - and I'm embarrassed to even discuss this: When you fill the knife block with the knives - make sure the sharp side of the big knives are all turned to the middle of the block. Otherwise - the sharp end hangs out over the edge of the block and is a significant danger. I loaded the knives without thinking about that and reached around the block at one point and got the top of my right thumb with the heal of one of the big knives that I loaded backwards. It got me good. I'll always have a scar there now. It was stupid and completely my mistake - so don't do the same thing. Be careful. the only blades that shouldn't have the sharp end pointing to the middle of the block would be the steak knives at the bottom. Those can be loaded with the sharp end down. The block will cover the apex just fine when loaded that way.

    Anyhow - I would recommend this set. Check the price history because the price does seem to bounce around a bit. It's a great deal when the price is down.

    4 out of 5 stars
    Nice set but not worth the retail price.
    Reviewed in the United States on June 9, 2025
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Nice set of knives for the 50+% off. Everything is pretty sharp and decently made. I would say they don’t value out to the $4xx.xx regular price. But at $2xx.xx they are worth it. We have been using $30-$100 knife sets for awhile and I finally wanted to move up to better tier of knives. Handles feel really nice in your hand, the pinch grip feature is really nice and makes you want to use them that way. The block is well built, the knives themselves have some weight to them so they don’t feel super cheap. They are made in china so you’re not going to be feeling the fine details of a high end set. They do their job well, look and feel good. 4 stars because they do have a made in china feel to them still. If I thought they were made by the Japanese I would be disappointed. Their quality is top notch and there’s minor imperfections that some will notice. I have already and will when on sale ad to this loong series.

About this Item

  • 【Professional Knife Set】16 piece kitchen knife set includes: 8" chef knife, 8" bread knife, 8" carving knife, 7" santoku knife, 7" fillet knife, 6" utility knife, 3.75" paring knife, 6pcs 4.5" steak knives, a knife sharpener, a pair of kitchen shears all stored in a knife block
  • 【Razor Shape Blade】The knife blade is sharpened with the latest sharpening technology to create a sharp angle of 15 degrees, which can cut tender meat, fish, fruits, vegetables, etc; With extreme precision, without tearing the food, allowing you to preserve the taste in the best way
  • 【Forged Japanese Steel】Made of high-quality Japanese 10Cr15CoMoV stainless steel, it has strong resistance to stain and rust; After high-temperature forging, the hardness reaches up to 58 HRC, which ensures that the kitchen knife is durable and remains sharp even in daily use
  • 【Ergonomic Handle】The handle is made of high-density pakkawood, which is not easy to crack and is famous for its hardness and exterior; The handle is designed to fit the palm perfectly, providing optimal grip and comfort, and will not cause fatigue when used for a long time
  • 【Easy Care & Store】HOSHANHO chef knife set comes with a knife holder with a ventilation design at the bottom, which is suitable for long-term storage of knives; The knife block set also comes with a sharpening rod for daily maintenance and sharpness maintenance of knives
